question: Why did the error rate go up on 07 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of auth v2.27 to ap-south likely caused the increase in error rate.
why_chain: The deployment of auth v2.27 to ap-south introduced a new version of the service.
The new version (v2.27) was deployed 2 minutes before the error rate spike.
The error rate increased significantly (from 0.49% to 4.43%) after the deployment.

contributing_factors.description: The change in the auth feature flag to 50% in ap-south may have contributed to the error rate increase.
why_chain: The feature flag change occurred 3 minutes before the error rate spike.
The feature flag change to 50% may have altered the service's behavior or performance.
The error rate spiked after the feature flag change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume remained about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The change in p95 latency caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency remained about the same before and after the change.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region ap-south rose from 0.49% to 4.43% (+807%), with a change point at 2026-03-07T07:10:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.10).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region ap-south stayed about the same (223 per 5 min before, 271 per 5 min after, +21%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region ap-south stayed about the same (91 ms before, 89 ms after, -1%).
Deployed auth v2.27 to ap-south (auth, ap-south; 2 min before the change; record R014)
Changed auth feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in ap-south (auth, ap-south; 3 min before the change; record R013)
High error rate on auth in ap-south (auth, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R015)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.27) (auth, ap-south; 19 min after the change; record R016)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.27) (auth, ap-south; 28 min after the change; record R017)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Roll back the deployment of auth v2.27 to ap-south.
Review and potentially revert the change in the auth feature flag to 50% in ap-south.
Monitor the error rate and request volume closely for any further spikes.
